presets.big: 底300 台100. Every 台 matters.

network.title: Network (development builds)
network.body: Game server for online tables and clubs. Leave empty to use this build's server (%{url}). Release builds always use the build's server.

account.title: Account
account.offline: Not connected to the game server yet. Playing online or opening Clubs creates a guest account; signing in keeps it safe across devices.
account.guestBody: Your progress and clubs are tied to this device. Sign in to keep them if you lose or replace it.
account.signedOutBody: The game server no longer accepts this device’s session for %{name}. Sign in again to get back to that account, or start fresh as a new guest.

prompt.title: Sign in to play online
prompt.body: This device remembers %{name}, but the game server needs you to sign in again before you can join a table or a club.
prompt.startFreshWarning: A new guest account starts from nothing: the progress, purchases and clubs of %{name} stay with that account until you sign in to it again.

account.noProviders: Sign-in with Apple or Google is not available on this server yet.
account.signOutGuestWarning: Signing out deletes nothing on the server, but this guest cannot be recovered afterwards: its progress, diamonds, looks and clubs will be lost to you. Sign in first to keep them.
account.deleteBody: This removes your account, name and club memberships from the server. Your diamonds and the looks you own are lost for good and cannot be restored. Purchase records are kept. Type %{word} to confirm.
account.deleteSubscription: %{plan} is active (renews or ends %{date}). Deleting your account does not cancel it: your App Store or Google Play account keeps billing until you cancel the subscription there.
account.deleteSubscriptionAck: I understand the subscription keeps billing until I cancel it in the store

legal.title: Legal
legal.body: The terms you play under and how your data is used. You can delete your account under Account above.
